name: Guild Street, Northern End
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts, and continues to the north and south. Directly
desc3: to the east you can see a pub, and judgeing from its appearance it
desc4: caters to the working class. Its door stands open, and you can hear
desc5: loud bellows of laughter coming from within. The scent of ale is
desc6: strong here. Off to the north, you can see the broad face of the city
